purpose: Give recurring AI news stable provider and story-theme visual families so readers can recognize what kind of update they are seeing before reading the headline.
selectionRule: Use the exact provider key when the story is primarily about that provider. Use the existing neutral testing-desk artwork only for cross-provider, benchmark-method or provider-neutral stories.
themeSelectionRule: Use the policy or security theme image when the topic is more important than a single provider. When both provider and topic matter, keep the provider image and show the existing visible story-type label such as Security Alert or Policy Update.
accessibilityRule: Every consumer must pair the image with a large deterministic product/company lockup and provider-specific alt text. Colour, motifs and generated text are never the sole identifier.
styleContract: adult editorial comic and graphic-novel linework
crisp ink contours and controlled halftone
no people, hands, faces or phantom body parts
no generated wordmarks or copied company logos
